run_do_env_rollout: run do_env_rollout to generate environment rollouts from a list of action sequences
run_discount_sum: run discount_sum to compute discounted cumulative rewards from a reward sequence
run_generate_perturbed_actions: run generate_perturbed_actions to create perturbed action sequences around a base action
run_generate_paths: run generate_paths to generate multiple rollout paths with perturbed actions
run_gather_paths_parallel: run gather_paths_parallel to collect rollout paths across multiple CPUs in parallel
